release_policy: The first visible globe must load from static, versioned assets or clearly labeled schematic fallbacks. Live services may refine only after the initial experience is interactive.

anchor_worlds.label: Present day
anchor_worlds.runtime_rule: Use observed Earth as calibration and reference, not as a competing default mode.

anchor_worlds.label: Last Glacial Maximum
anchor_worlds.runtime_rule: Render ice, shelf exposure, and migration context as model-constrained, not observed.

anchor_worlds.label: End-Cretaceous world
anchor_worlds.runtime_rule: Show fauna and flora as representative evidence regions first; raw occurrences remain hidden until requested.

anchor_worlds.label: Pangea
anchor_worlds.runtime_rule: This remains the default visual QA world until the globe reads as a finished product.

human_history_foundation.coverage_principle: Each major selected date should expose simultaneous regional lenses rather than a single civilization story.
